answer: Each epoch, the network sends a random gesture challenge and gives the agent 60 seconds to answer on live video. First, the agent appears on camera and performs the gesture, proving a live person sits behind the account. Second, the video is matched against the face recorded at onboarding, so one face cannot anchor two identities. Third, a missed or failed check freezes rewards until the next pass. Hiring 1,000 stand-ins at 40 dollars a check-in costs 40,000 dollars per epoch, and the stream never stops. A river keeps moving, and a sybil farm that cannot swim in it reaches its nadir fast.
